name: Aarav Mehta
title: Fresh and sophisticated fragrance
review: Cold Call has such a refreshing opening. The citrus notes are noticeable immediately, but what I really love is how it settles into a warm woody fragrance. Perfect for office and evening outings.

name: Ananya Sharma
title: My new everyday perfume
review: Absolutely loving this fragrance! It smells clean, fresh and expensive without being overpowering. The bergamot and grapefruit combination is beautiful. Definitely something I would wear every day.

name: Rohan Kapoor
title: Great citrus and woody combination
review: The first spray feels very energetic and citrusy. After some time, the woody notes become more prominent, which I personally enjoy. Good fragrance for someone who likes fresh aromatic perfumes.

name: Priya Nair
title: Smells incredibly premium
review: I was not expecting to like this perfume so much. It has a very balanced fragrance profile. Not too sweet, not too sharp. The dry down is probably my favourite part. ❤️

name: Kabir Malhotra
title: Perfect for daytime wear
review: If you enjoy fresh perfumes with a slightly spicy character, this is worth exploring. The ginger and citrus combination gives it a distinctive personality. The packaging is also quite elegant.

name: Ishita Verma
title: A refreshing fragrance
review: Really liked the fresh opening of this perfume. It has a citrusy feel initially and gradually becomes more woody. I would have preferred a little more sweetness, but overall a lovely fragrance.

name: Arjun Singh
title: Worth trying for fragrance lovers
review: The combination of bergamot, grapefruit and vetiver is really interesting. It smells modern and classy. I especially like that it doesn't feel like another generic sweet perfume.

name: Meera Iyer
title: Love the fresh citrus opening
review: The citrus notes are absolutely beautiful. It gives such a fresh and energetic feeling. Later the woody and musky notes make it feel more mature. A very interesting fragrance journey.

name: Dev Khanna
title: Clean masculine fragrance
review: A very nice fresh aromatic perfume. The ginger and peppermint add something different to the usual citrus fragrance profile. Works nicely for casual outings and professional settings.

name: Sana Sheikh
title: Such a beautiful dry down
review: The opening is bright and refreshing, but the dry down is where this perfume really shines. The patchouli and ambergris notes give it a lovely warm character. Very sophisticated.

name: Vihaan Joshi
title: Not your typical citrus perfume
review: I usually find citrus perfumes too simple, but Cold Call has much more depth. The spices and woody base make it interesting. It transitions beautifully from fresh to warm.

name: Tanya Kapoor
title: Elegant and refreshing
review: The fragrance feels very polished. I like the balance between fresh citrus and earthy woody notes. It is not an overly sweet fragrance, which is exactly what I was looking for.

name: Aditya Rao
title: A great addition to my collection
review: The 30% oil concentration caught my attention, and I really like the fragrance profile. The grapefruit and bergamot opening is excellent. The bottle also looks minimal and premium.

name: Nisha Agarwal
title: Fresh spicy and woody perfection
review: This is such a well-rounded fragrance. The initial citrus freshness is uplifting, while the ginger and lavender give it a little complexity. The woody base makes it feel very elegant. ✨

name: Reyansh Bhatia
title: Nice fragrance but quite different
review: The perfume opens with a strong citrus character, which I enjoyed. However, the woody and earthy dry down was a little different from what I usually wear. Still a good option for people who enjoy aromatic fragrances.
